+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/hdt3213/godis/config"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	// Test the new ParseBool function directly
+	fmt.Println("Testing ParseBool function:")
+	testCases := []string{"yes", "true", "1", "on", "YES", "True", "ON", "no", "false", "0", "off", "random"}
+	for _, tc := range testCases {
+		result := config.ParseBool(tc)
+		fmt.Printf("ParseBool('%s') = %t\n", tc, result)
+	}
+
+	// Test parsing config with different boolean representations
+	fmt.Println("\nTesting config parsing:")
+	src := "bind 0.0.0.0\n" +
+		"port 6399\n" +
+		"appendonly yes\n" +
+		"use-gnet true\n" +
+		"cluster-enable 1\n" +
+		"aof-use-rdb-preamble on\n"
+		
+	p := config.Parse(strings.NewReader(src))
+	if p != nil {
+		fmt.Printf("Bind: %s\n", p.Bind)
+		fmt.Printf("Port: %d\n", p.Port)
+		fmt.Printf("AppendOnly (yes): %t\n", p.AppendOnly)
+		fmt.Printf("UseGnet (true): %t\n", p.UseGnet)
+		fmt.Printf("ClusterEnable (1): %t\n", p.ClusterEnable)
+		fmt.Printf("AofUseRdbPreamble (on): %t\n", p.AofUseRdbPreamble)
+	} else {
+		fmt.Println("Failed to parse config")
+	}

func parse(src io.Reader) *ServerProperties {
	config := &ServerProperties{}

	// read config file
	rawMap := make(map[string]string)
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(src)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		line := scanner.Text()
		if len(line) > 0 && strings.TrimLeft(line, " ")[0] == '#' {
			continue
		}
		pivot := strings.IndexAny(line, " ")
		if pivot > 0 && pivot < len(line)-1 { // separator found
			key := line[0:pivot]
			value := strings.Trim(line[pivot+1:], " ")
			rawMap[strings.ToLower(key)] = value
		}
	}
	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal(err)
	}

	// parse format
	t := reflect.TypeOf(config)
	v := reflect.ValueOf(config)
	n := t.Elem().NumField()
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		field := t.Elem().Field(i)
		fieldVal := v.Elem().Field(i)
		key, ok := field.Tag.Lookup("cfg")
		if !ok || strings.TrimLeft(key, " ") == "" {

		value, ok := rawMap[strings.ToLower(key)]
		if ok {

			case reflect.Int:

					fieldVal.Set(reflect.ValueOf(slice))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return config
}

+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/hdt3213/godis/config"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	// Test the new ParseBool function directly
+	fmt.Println("Testing ParseBool function:")
+	testCases := []string{"yes", "true", "1", "on", "YES", "True", "ON", "no", "false", "0", "off", "random"}
+	for _, tc := range testCases {
+		result := config.ParseBool(tc)
+		fmt.Printf("ParseBool('%s') = %t\n", tc, result)
+	}
+
+	// Test parsing config with different boolean representations
+	fmt.Println("\nTesting config parsing:")
+	src := "bind 0.0.0.0\n" +
+		"port 6399\n" +
+		"appendonly yes\n" +
+		"use-gnet true\n" +
+		"cluster-enable 1\n" +
+		"aof-use-rdb-preamble on\n"
+		
+	p := config.Parse(strings.NewReader(src))
+	if p != nil {
+		fmt.Printf("Bind: %s\n", p.Bind)
+		fmt.Printf("Port: %d\n", p.Port)
+		fmt.Printf("AppendOnly (yes): %t\n", p.AppendOnly)
+		fmt.Printf("UseGnet (true): %t\n", p.UseGnet)
+		fmt.Printf("ClusterEnable (1): %t\n", p.ClusterEnable)
+		fmt.Printf("AofUseRdbPreamble (on): %t\n", p.AofUseRdbPreamble)
+	} else {
+		fmt.Println("Failed to parse config")
+	}
+}
